intro.title: SoftRenderer Project Overview
intro.desc: SoftRenderer is my graphics-learning project focused on implementing a CPU-side rendering pipeline from scratch. The current target is to complete a clean, testable baseline including vertex transforms, triangle rasterization, depth testing, and basic shading.

text: This page is the base structure for the SoftRenderer project documentation. It follows the same architecture as other project pages so future content can be added consistently.
At this stage, I am building the foundational rendering pipeline: geometry transform, viewport mapping, triangle setup, rasterization, depth comparison, and final framebuffer output.
After the baseline pipeline is stable, I will add richer demos, core code snippets, and a deeper explanation of design decisions and performance tradeoffs.
